Days, BJD in TCB minus 2455197.5. DR3 TAP_SCHEMA gives only 'd'; the DR3 values fall inside the DR3 time span on that scale (results/dr3_checks.md).
Per day. Period in days = 1 / frequency. Period > 100 d is frequency < 0.01. The table has no period column.
Per day. Error on the period grows with the time since reference_time: phase error after dt days is about dt * frequency_error cycles.
G magnitude outside eclipse, from the model.

DR4 draft values: ONEGAUSSIAN, ONEGAUSSIAN_WITH_ELLIPSOIDAL, TWOGAUSSIANS, TWOGAUSSIANS_WITH_ELLIPSOIDAL_ON_ECLIPSE1, TWOGAUSSIANS_WITH_ELLIPSOIDAL_ON_ECLIPSE2, ELLIPSOIDAL. ELLIPSOIDAL has no eclipse. DR3 values are listed in results/dr3_checks.md.
Integer type is narrower in DR4 (byte); no effect on queries.
Phase relative to reference_time. DR3 values lie between 0 and 1. Empty when the model has no Gaussian (the 82 long-period ELLIPSOIDAL stars in DR3). The DR4 draft says NaN.
A fraction of the period, not days. Days = duration * period.
Magnitudes in G.
Phase relative to reference_time. Empty (NaN in the DR4 draft) when there is no second Gaussian.
A fraction of the period, not days.
DR4 only. Compares the model frequency with the radial-velocity period. 3 means the RV frequency is half the model frequency, 2 means double, 1 consistent, 0 inconsistent, -1 and -2 no usable RV.
DR4 only. String class from Mowlavi et al. (2023) Table A.1, per the data model.
DR4 only. Median G of the input light curve. Useful next to gaia_source.phot_g_mean_mag.
DR4 only. Number of G observations in the input light curve.
DR4 only. Score of the classifier that chose the stars to process.
DR3 has two copies, vari_planetary_transit and vari_planetary_transit_13june2022 (214 rows each).
Days, BJD in TCB minus 2455197.5. A mid-transit time near the middle of the Gaia data. Transit n happens at transit_reference_time + n * transit_period.
Days. The table has no error on the period, so predictions far from transit_reference_time cannot be given an uncertainty from this table.
Milli-magnitudes.
Days (not a phase fraction). Data model: a time t is in transit if abs(mod(t - T0 + P/2, P) - P/2) < w/2.
Number of Gaia observations inside transits. Integer type is narrower in DR4.

DR4 gaia_source only holds sources with both high-quality astrometry and photometry (Gaia DR4 page, 14 Sep 2026). In DR3 every variable star is in gaia_source. In DR4 an eclipsing binary can be missing from it: use a LEFT JOIN and check all_source_astrometry and all_source_photometry.
DR4 reference epoch J2017.5, DR3 J2016.0 (Gaia DR4 page). Positions and proper motions refer to it.
DR4 only. Names the table that gave the G magnitude. vari_eclipsing_binary means the EB model. Select it to know which G you have.

In DR4 the G value of an eclipsing binary can come from the eclipsing-binary model (see g_photometry_origin). Then phot_g_n_obs is 0. What the model value stands for (mean or out of eclipse) is not stated in the draft.
DR4 only. Names the table that gave BP and RP.
Same definition. In DR4 BP and RP can also come from variability models (Cepheids, RR Lyrae).
Values VARIABLE, POSSIBLE, NON_VARIABLE or empty in the DR4 draft.
DR4 only. Which module gave teff, logg and mh.
Renamed and changed in meaning. DR4 teff is the value from the module named in ap_origin (GSP-Phot, GSP-Spec and others). DR3 teff_gspphot is GSP-Phot only. Not the same quantity.
Not in DR4 gaia_source. The draft lists it in all_source_astrometry.
Not in DR4 gaia_source (the draft lists no such column there).
Not in DR4 gaia_source. Compute phot_bp_mean_mag - phot_g_mean_mag.
Not in DR4 gaia_source. Compute phot_g_mean_mag - phot_rp_mean_mag.

Not in DR4 gaia_source. The draft lists has_epoch_photometry in all_source_flags.

DR4 ID. Stand-in column is the DR3 ID in dr2_neighbourhood.
The older ID. Stand-in column is the DR2 ID, which the TESS Input Catalog uses.
